pages.text: [#](53341a)A spirit bound to a physical object becomes something useful — the scarecrow that watches with intent, the effigy that senses intrusion, the ladder that extends a boundary.[#]()
pages.title: Fetishes

pages.text: [#](53341a)To make a fetish, place the host object in a medium circle with an Attuned Stone, a Necromantic Stone, and a Boline, then sacrifice the required spirits near the circle.[#]()
[#](53341a)The rite binds them to the vessel.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Voodoo Protection** makes carried protection poppets more effective nearby. **Sentinel** sends spectres against uninvited guests.[#]()
pages.title: What a Fetish Does

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Shrieking** emits a redstone pulse and a banshee's cry. **Disorientation** leaves armed or armored trespassers with unreliable senses.[#]()
[#](53341a)**Ghost Walking** spares those walking the spirit world nearby from being hurried back.[#]()
[#](53341a)Use a Boline to cycle the trigger mode, and a Taglock Kit to say who counts as an intruder.[#]()
